s1.title: Create an account
s1.text: Sign up with your email, create a workspace and add your first property.

s2.title: Build the website
s2.text: Pick blocks, enter room types, prices and policies, and connect PayOS.

s3.title: Take bookings
s3.text: Guests book and pay deposits on the website; bookings show up in your management pages at once.

q1.q: Which account do guests' deposits go to?
q1.a: Straight to the hotel's bank account connected to PayOS. Digistay never holds the hotel's money.

q2.q: Can I use my own domain?
q2.a: Yes. The website runs on your-hotel.digistay.vn, and you can point your hotel's own domain to it.

q3.q: Does the website have an English version?
q3.a: Yes. International guests switch to English right on the website.

q4.q: How many properties can one account manage?
q4.a: A workspace holds several properties: {starter} on Starter, {growth} on Growth, {business} on Business. You can buy more.

q5.a: Yes, through Mắt Bão: issue, adjust and replace invoices, and email them to guests.

q6.q: Can front desk staff see revenue?
q6.a: No. Revenue reports are only shown to Owners and Managers; the front desk sees and handles bookings, check-in and check-out.

cta.title: Open an account and build your hotel's website
cta.lead: Want to talk first? Leave your details and the Digistay team will get in touch.

rows.pricing: Prices by room type, weekends, extra charges

q1.q: How do I pay for Digistay?
q1.a: By bank transfer, monthly or yearly. Paying yearly saves two months.

q2.q: Does Digistay issue VAT invoices for its fees?
q2.a: Yes. An e-invoice is emailed to the workspace owner after each payment.

q3.a: No. Any PayOS fee follows the hotel's own contract with PayOS; Digistay takes nothing from guests' deposits.

q4.q: What if I change plans mid-cycle?
q4.a: Upgrades apply at once and you pay the difference for the days left in the cycle. Downgrades apply from the next cycle.

q5.q: What happens to my bookings if I stop?
q5.a: You can export your bookings before you stop. The data is kept for 30 more days, then deleted.
